# Security and data handling

## Synthetic-only repository

This repository is public and must remain **synthetic-data only**.

Do not commit:

- real patient names;
- MRNs or FINs;
- dates or other fields copied from identifiable patient records;
- PCORI/PCORnet extracts containing real patient-level data;
- GWTG exports containing real patient-level data;
- REDCap production exports;
- API tokens, passwords, or REDCap secrets.

Synthetic identifiers generated by this repository are deliberately prefixed with `SYN-`.

## Generated files

Generated demonstration datasets are written under `synthetic_data/outputs/` and are ignored by Git. The generation code, not the generated datasets, is the source of truth.

## Production boundary

The current Streamlit application is a workflow prototype. It is not configured for production clinical use, authentication, authorization, audit logging, or storage of PHI.

Any future production REDCap implementation should use institutional hosting, approved access controls, role-based permissions, audit logs, approved integration methods, and the applicable Penn State Health privacy/security review.

## If real data are accidentally committed

Do not treat a normal follow-up commit as sufficient removal from a public repository. Stop using the affected branch/repository and follow institutional security/privacy procedures for containment and history cleanup.
